picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first Genesis Mission awards signals a major new DOE national initiative putting AI at the center of scientific discovery, from particle physics to materials science.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A University of Alabama-Fermilab partnership under the same Genesis Mission shows the program's reach into fundamental physics, using AI to sift massive particle-collision datasets.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub at Cambridge combining stem cell models with AI could meaningfully accelerate drug development timelines, a high-value bet on AI-driven medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: An ARPA-H-backed collaboration between SRI, Mayo Clinic, and UF to guide clinical procedures with AI-driven smart glasses represents a concrete, near-term real-world AI application in healthcare.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot's billion-dollar valuation as TUM's 23rd unicorn is a striking financial milestone showing how quickly AI agent startups from academic spinouts are scaling.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel Prize-winning techniques, represents a genuine scientific breakthrough with broad biotech implications.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a new global standard for evaluating embodied AI robots, a significant infrastructure contribution to the field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots marks a substantial defense-research investment in next-generation robotics.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: The launch of a dedicated AI for African Population Health Unit at the University of Cape Town, backed by South Africa's Medical Research Council, is a notable step toward AI tools tailored to underserved health contexts.
picks.title: New unit a shot in the arm for healthcare research in Africa

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky winning the 2026 Dirac Medal recognizes foundational theoretical work connecting AI and neuroscience, a prestigious honor underscoring the scientific depth behind modern AI.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal
